concerns.text: FR-007 and plan.md (Scale/Scope) require generating synthetic series across a grid of 5 sample sizes (100, 500, 1k, 5k, 10k). T019 only mandates lengths '≥ 1,000' and lacks a specific task to generate the N-variation grid required for the regression analysis in FR-005.

FR-005 and plan.md require regressing error rates against Hurst exponent AND log(N_eff) (with interaction) to validate the VIF mechanism. T028 mentions calculating VIF/N_eff but fails to explicitly task the regression against log(N_eff) or the interaction term, leaving the core validation mechanism uncovered.

FR-003 and FR-005 require comparing observed test statistics against a null distribution (shuffled versions) for EVERY series (real and synthetic). T029 only references comparing 'real data' against the null distribution, omitting the required comparison for synthetic series needed to validate SC-001 and isolate inflation mechanisms.

FR-002 requires computing ACF, Hurst, and spectral density for 'every loaded series' (real and synthetic). T014 is scoped to US1 (Data Acquisition) and does not explicitly mandate calculating these metrics for the synthetic series generated in US2, creating a gap where synthetic metrics required for FR-007 and FR-005 regression may not be computed.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Principle V (Versioning Discipline) mandate that checksums be recorded in the project's state YAML file. T007 only tasks setting up 'checksum validation logic' without a specific task to implement the recording of these checksums into the state file, risking a violation of the Single Source of Truth.

User Story 1 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires resampling the UK National Grid Load dataset to a consistent frequency (e.g., hourly) before stationarity testing. T013 implements ADF/differencing/detrending but lacks an explicit task to perform the required resampling step.

FR-006 and plan.md require visualizations including 'VIF curves' and scatter plots with regression lines/confidence intervals to verify SC-002. T030 lists 'ACF plots, scatter plots... and QQ-plots' but omits the explicit requirement for VIF curves and the specific regression visualization details.
